label: What trimming and combining say when they refuse or finish

params.name: bad_range
params.default: The end has to come after the start.

params.name: too_short
params.default: That piece is shorter than {min}s - there would be nothing to watch.

params.name: need_two
params.default: Pick at least two recordings to join.

params.name: too_many
params.default: At most {max} pieces can be joined at once.

params.name: not_yours
params.default: One of those recordings is not yours.

params.name: source_gone
params.default: The recording for "{title}" is no longer on this server.

description_nl: Every word trimming and combining say. {min} is the shortest piece allowed, {duration} the length of the recording, {n} how many pieces, {reason} ffmpeg's own last line.

expect_value.bad_range: The end has to come after the start.
expect_value.too_short: That piece is shorter than {min}s - there would be nothing to watch.
expect_value.need_two: Pick at least two recordings to join.
expect_value.too_many: At most {max} pieces can be joined at once.
expect_value.not_yours: One of those recordings is not yours.
expect_value.source_gone: The recording for "{title}" is no longer on this server.

weight_basis: Wording only. Every sentence trimming and combining show lives here, never in Python.
